practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Keep client/server allocation reasoning, repair implication client-only validation is sufficient. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
practice_questions.solution: Local check gives rapid feedback without a request. Server cannot trust arbitrary clients, so it revalidates received data. The authoritative database is server-side, and uniqueness must be checked there against current stored records.

marking_points.criterion: Local check gives immediate feedback/reduces needless requests.
Server revalidates because clients can bypass checks.
Authoritative stored data are on server.
Uniqueness checked against current database, not only local client state.
